# A template that does not parse is reported, one line, and the other
# files are still formatted.

! muxt fmt -w page.gohtml good.gohtml
cmp stderr want-err.txt
cmp good.gohtml want-good.gohtml
cmp page.gohtml page.orig

-- page.gohtml --
<div>
{{if .X}}
</div>
-- page.orig --
<div>
{{if .X}}
</div>
-- good.gohtml --
<ul>
<li>one</li>
</ul>
-- want-good.gohtml --
<ul>
	<li>one</li>
</ul>
-- want-err.txt --
page.gohtml:4:1: unexpected EOF
